notes: HN Hot is intentionally separate from the main hot-news pipeline.
These queries search HN Algolia historical stories by topic keywords.
They are not used to decide news.xml or radar.xml membership.
Use concise OR expressions and keep every query focused on one durable reading theme.

queries.name: ai-learning
queries.query: "AI learning" OR "learn AI" OR "machine learning course" OR "LLM learning"
queries.notes: Historical learning resources for AI/ML/LLM study. This is keyword driven by design and belongs only in hn-hot.xml.

queries.name: devops-classics
queries.query: Kubernetes OR Postgres OR Linux OR observability OR "distributed systems"
queries.notes: Durable engineering infrastructure classics. This is keyword driven by design and belongs only in hn-hot.xml.
